name.ja: Figure-rise Standard ULTRAMAN SUIT DARKLOPS ZERO -ACTION-
name.en: Figure-rise Standard ULTRAMAN SUIT DARKLOPS ZERO -ACTION-

description.ja: 月刊ホビージャパン連載の『ULTRAMAN SUIT ANOTHER UNIVERSE』より、ウルトラマンゼロのライバル「ダークロプスゼロ」がULTRAMAN SUITで登場！
description.en: From "ULTRAMAN SUIT ANOTHER UNIVERSE " serialized in Hobby Japan, Ultraman Zero's rival " Darklops Zero" appears in ULTRAMAN SUIT!

description.ja: ■特徴的なモノアイを新規パーツで再現。
description.en: • Reproduce the characteristic mono-eye with new parts.

description.ja: ■腹部関節は「可動優先時」と「LEDユニット（別売り）内蔵時」の２パターンの選択式。
description.en: • The abdominal joint can be selected from two patterns: "when movable is prioritized " and " when the LED unit (sold separately) is built in".

description.ja: ■LEDユニット（別売り）を胸部に収め、胸と目を光らせることができる。
description.en: • An LED unit (sold separately) can be placed in the chest to make the chest and eyes shine.

accessories.ja: ハンドパーツ（左右）×各2種
accessories.en: Hand parts (left and right) x 2 types each
